scope: Non-operational computational analysis of already-public longitudinal SARS-CoV-2 measurements. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, clinical recommendation, or treatment claim.

meta_registry_transfer.principle: Measure both directional successor-information channels under one frozen rule before deciding which compartment, if either, acts as a useful leading coordinate.

already_known: dataset schema and source non-detection codes
C031 results for adding culture time-to-positivity to next-day nasal/saliva prediction
exposure_boundary.rule: C031 culture-state results may not be used as a feature or tuning signal in C032.

eligibility: unique subject-Time key at t and t+1
finite current and next-day Nasal_CN with both <48
finite current and next-day Saliva_Ct with both <47
exact one-day successor only; no interpolation
no filtering by lineage, age, antigen, culture, Index or post-hoc subgroup
shared_endpoint.cross_validation: leave-one-subject-out ordinary least squares using numpy.linalg.lstsq; pooled held-out MAE
shared_endpoint.ambiguous_duplicate_rule: exclude duplicate subject-Time keys rather than averaging

primary_hypothesis.statement: The two compartments are directionally non-equivalent at successor prediction: current saliva carries materially more information about next-day nasal change than current nasal carries about next-day saliva change.
primary_hypothesis.anti_cherry_pick: Both directions are always reported. A strong N->S result with weak S->N is a directional MISS, not relabeled success.

nulls.SN: globally permute current Saliva_Ct across frozen eligible transitions, rerun identical LOSO enriched model
nulls.NS: globally permute current Nasal_CN across frozen eligible transitions, rerun identical LOSO enriched model

frozen_terminal.PASS: n>=30 transitions and >=10 subjects; G_SN>=0.10; p_SN<=0.01; G_SN-G_NS>=0.05; and the enriched S->N model improves MAE.
frozen_terminal.FAIL: G_SN<=0; or p_SN>0.05; or G_SN-G_NS<=0; or a clearly opposite N->S dominance satisfies the same material-effect logic.
frozen_terminal.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: eligibility below minimum or intermediate values that meet neither PASS nor FAIL.
